Posting your answers to the ticket was declined, so I haven't posted anything. They're saved word for word in my scratchpad. Should I post them to the ticket? I'd want to, because your Q2, Q3 and Q5 answers bear on other tickets too.

Here's where your answers leave things, followed by round two.

*

The questions they answer are summarized here in one line each; the Q2, Q3 and Q5 answers reach beyond this ticket, and will be linked from the tickets they bear on when this one resolves.\"; echo; echo \"- Q1: what makes a rule binding (what it is about, who owns it, both, or case by case).\"; echo \"- Q2: how the writer's knowledge about the route is written (left out, as a resource with its reason, or as an overridable default).\"; echo \"- Q3: what happens to bars on what gets reported (report everything and filter in a separate step, reword bars as ranking, or case by case).\"; echo \"- Q4: one mechanism for departing from a route or a rule, in place of the factory's five.\"; echo \"- Q5: whether cost or time can justify limiting the route.\"; echo; sed '1,2d' \"$f\" | sed 's/^/> /'; echo; echo \"Posted to keep Manuel's words, per his standing request on the map.\"; echo; echo \"Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code\"; } > /tmp/body152.md 2>/dev/null || true; body=\"$(dirname \"$f\")/body152.md\"; mv /tmp/body152.md \"$body\" 2>/dev/null; gh issue comment 152 --body-file \"$body\""}
